note: What Raven checks, what each source can and cannot prove, and what happens on failure. Raven fails closed; optional evidence becomes a coverage gap when not supplied or not checkable.

sources.name: token mint account
sources.trust_boundary: Solana RPC (server-side; callers never supply RPC)
sources.proves: issuer authorities (mint/freeze), supply, decimals, Token-2022 extension tail incl. unknown-extension detection
sources.cannot_prove: off-chain intent, team identity, future behavior

sources.name: tokenProgramAddress (caller-supplied)
sources.trust_boundary: caller input, validated against known programs
sources.proves: which decoding rules apply (SPL vs Token-2022)

sources.name: metadata account (optional)
sources.failure_behavior: coverage stays limited; explicit finding or gap

sources.name: pool account (optional, Raydium CPMM)
sources.trust_boundary: Solana RPC; layout validated vs mainnet fixtures
sources.proves: LP supply/custody (burn/locker), registered vault addresses for holder exclusion

sources.name: holder accounts (beta, key-gated)
sources.trust_boundary: Solana RPC; venue custody only with decoded on-chain evidence (pump.fun curve, registered PumpSwap vaults)
sources.proves: top-holder concentration, venue-adjusted where evidence exists
sources.cannot_prove: CEX custody, Raydium v4 data-less vaults (reported unadjusted)
sources.failure_behavior: unresolved -> warning; unadjusted carries explicit qualifier + gap

sources.name: attestation public key
sources.trust_boundary: served by the verifier at /pubkey; cross-checkable in repo
sources.proves: receipt integrity and signing-key control (ed25519, domain-separated); Raven attribution requires an independently pinned signer key
sources.failure_behavior: signer unavailable -> 503, never an unsigned receipt

sources.name: engine version
sources.trust_boundary: stamped by the engine into every deliverable
sources.proves: which finding vocabulary produced the verdict; coverage expansion segmented from state change

assetBackedLimitation.rule: Raven verifies supported on-chain evidence only. For stablecoins, RWAs, tokenized securities, tokenized funds, wrapped assets, fan tokens, or branded tokens, a receipt does NOT prove legal redeemability, full reserves, issuer approval or solvency, regulatory compliance, bankruptcy remoteness, securities status, or real-world asset custody unless a supported evidence source is explicitly included in the receipt.
assetBackedLimitation.coverageGapRule: Unsupported off-chain claims appear as coverage gaps - never as silent assumptions.
assetBackedLimitation.context: The market is moving toward serious-looking tokens: brand, athlete, stablecoin, RWA, and institutional narratives. Looking institutional is not evidence.
